item.title: Bangladesh Government Orders Judicial Service Officials to Submit Wealth Statements Within 10 Days
item.description: Bangladesh government has issued a directive requiring all judiciary officials and their family members to submit detailed wealth statements within 10 working days. This order, aimed at ensuring accountability, applies to all levels of the Bangladesh Judicial Service. As the deadline approaches, this initiative is expected to provide greater insight into the financial integrity of those entrusted with upholding the law. Read more about the government's push for transparency in the judiciary.
